content: An AI agent is an assistant you set up for a recurring task. Its instructions guide the replies, its Knowledge base provides document context, and Chat outputs holds saved results.

comment.text: Body of the first AI Agents onboarding tour step, anchored on the AI agents item in the left sidebar; admin variant (non-admins see AgentWhatIsShared). Knowledge base and Chat outputs are UI section names.
